meta_description: JMS Decorating and Handyman in Leicester offers professional interior and exterior painting, decorating, and general handyman services. Free quotes available.
hero_eyebrow: Professional Painter & Decorator — Quality Results, Fair Prices
hero_subhead: From a single room refresh to a complete home makeover, we transform your space with care and precision.
services_heading: Complete Decorating & Handyman Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: Whether you need a fresh coat of paint, wallpaper hanging, or general home repairs, we've got you covered.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Full interior redecoration including wall and ceiling painting, woodwork, and feature walls. We prepare surfaces properly and use quality paints that last.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior work on fascias, soffits, doors, windows, and rendered walls. We protect your home and enhance kerb appeal.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging
services.desc: Professional wallpaper selection and installation on any wall type. We handle pattern matching, corners, and difficult spaces with precision.

services.title: Handyman Services
services.desc: General repairs and maintenance including shelving, tiling, flooring, and minor carpentry work. One tradesperson for all your small jobs.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Shop fronts, offices, and commercial properties painted to the highest standard. We work around your schedule with minimal disruption.

services.title: Furniture Upcycling & Staining
services.desc: Refresh old furniture with professional staining, varnishing, and painting. Transform tired pieces into stunning focal points for any room.

about_pullquote: We show up on time, do the job right, and treat your home with respect.
about_para_1: JMS Decorating and Handyman has been serving Leicester homes and businesses for over a decade. What started as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted local service, built on word-of-mouth recommendations and genuine craftsmanship. We take pride in every project, no matter how small.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen, we're reliable, and we deliver consistent quality. We don't cut corners with cheap materials or rush jobs. From a small touch-up to a complete renovation, you get the same level of care and attention to detail every single time.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Customers Say About JMS Decorating

reviews.text: Had the whole lounge redecorated and it looks brilliant. Mark was professional, tidy, and finished on time. Didn't leave a mess and prices were exactly as quoted. Would recommend to anyone.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Been using JMS for years now. First time was the kitchen, then the bedrooms, now the hallway. Never had a problem. Friendly, honest, and the workmanship is spot on. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Got a quick quote for painting the outside of the house. Very reasonable price and they were ready to start within a week. Did a proper job — paint's already looking as good as new after the winter. Really pleased.
reviews.author: Michael P.
